# Extra packages the serving image needs ON TOP of models/model/requirements.txt.
#
# models/model/requirements.txt is generated by MLflow when the model is logged:
# it lists exactly what is needed to load the model (mlflow, cloudpickle,
# numpy, torchvision -> torch, pillow), pinned to the versions used in training.
# This file adds only what the web server itself imports (source/serve.py and
# the functions it reuses from source/deployment.py).
#
# NOT the project's requirements.txt - that one is for development/training
# (jupyter, ruff, matplotlib, boto3, ...) and would make the image much bigger.
fastapi
uvicorn
scipy
pandas
requests
